alignment.method: For each UTC forecast hour, arithmetic-mean its two FUELHH half-hour average-MW values; hours missing either value are excluded from matched metrics.

errorDefinition: forecast - actual (MW); positive means overforecast, negative means underforecast.

method.forecastSelection: For each delivery hour, select the forecast with the latest publishTime at or before the local D-1 cutoff.
method.mapeGuard: Exclude actual generation with absolute value at or below 100 MW.
method.windLevelBuckets: Terciles of matched actual generation across the January decision sample.
method.uncertaintyBand: Empirical central 80% interval for actual generation: forecast minus P90(error) to forecast minus P10(error).
method.recommendedBuffer: P90 of absolute forecast error across matched January decision hours.
method.quantiles: Linear interpolation between sorted observed values (type 7).

limitations: WINDFOR is hourly; actuals are aligned by averaging pairs of half-hourly FUELHH values.
Uncertainty and buffer estimates use one January 2026 sample and may not generalize to other seasons or market conditions.
Missing actual or cutoff-eligible forecast values are retained as gaps and excluded from metrics; no imputation is performed.
The recommended buffer is a historical absolute-error quantile and does not model demand, prices, or the costs of over- and under-procurement.
